FULL TEXT:
NOTICE
No.ITC/2375/2026
Invitation for Suggestions / Feedback for End-to-End Paperless Working of
the High Court and Registry of the High Court of Gujarat.
It is hereby notified for the information of all the Learned Advocates, and
Stakeholders that the High Court of Gujarat is actively moving towards
complete digital transformation and end-to-end paperless functioning across
the Court proceedings as well as the Registry.
To ensure a seamless transition and incorporate practical insights from the
Bar, a dedicated feedback mechanism has been launched on the official
website of the High Court of Gujarat.
Learned Advocates and concerned stakeholders are requested to submit their
valuable suggestions, feedback, and inputs regarding paperless court
operations, e-filing, digital court management, and workflows by visiting the
link below:
https://gujarathighcourt.nic.in/egujhcfeedback
Constructive suggestions will play a vital role in refining and enhancing the
digital infrastructure, ensuring efficiency, transparency, and convenience for
all concerned.
By Order,
Date: 29/10/2026 Sd/-
Registrar (SCMS & ICT)
